findings.evidence: Open `.gitignore` at the repository root and add `build/` on its own line
findings.note: The procedure never addresses the case where .gitignore does not yet exist, leaving a fresh instance to guess whether to create the file versus edit an existing one.

findings.evidence: The working directory is the repository root. `.gitignore` and the ignored path are both interpreted relative to it, so run `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` and `cd` there first if you are not sure.
findings.note: The stated assumptions (repo root, git on PATH, path untracked) cover what the procedure actually relies on.

Verification only checks that some ignore rule matches the path, not that the directory is untracked, so running the skill on an already-tracked directory (which the description says has no effect) would still report success even though git status keeps listing the files.
